expected_symptom: ID3D12FunctionReflection exposes no ray payload size; shader kind is obtainable only via undocumented values in D3D12_FUNCTION_DESC.Version
history: always-repro'd across all 20 stable release DLLs v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607; fixed-harness matrix, not dxc.exe bisection
summary: Feature request, still open. Function type is already encoded in D3D12_FUNCTION_DESC.Version: D3D12_SHVER_GET_TYPE returns the correct DXR kind for all 7 test functions on main and every stable release, but shipped d3d12shader.h enum names stop at value 5, so callers lack public names for DXIL kinds 6-15. Payload size is not exposed by D3D12_FUNCTION_DESC (all 31 numeric fields enumerated and searched with an in-predicate self-test), although RDAT has carried PayloadSizeInBytes since 0a098d7cb (2018-02) and dx.entryPoints carries the same data. No release package ships the RDAT reader. This is an API-surface request, not a data-capture one.
text_stale: The function-type half is already satisfiable today via D3D12_SHVER_GET_TYPE(D3D12_FUNCTION_DESC.Version); only the payload size is genuinely unreachable, and it is present in the container RDAT part.
title: Expose ray payload size / function type through Reflection
